stage: DISCOVERY -- direction and coefficient frozen before validation
direction_source: mean over the 12 discovery tasks of h[no_history] - h[self_low_2]

success_criteria.primary: steering self_low_2 toward no_history at L24 produces mean normalized movement > 0 with a task-bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0
success_criteria.control_1: learned-direction normalized movement exceeds the early-layer L2 arm
success_criteria.control_2: learned-direction normalized movement exceeds the norm-matched random-direction arm
success_criteria.specificity: shifts induced under no_history and unrelated_low_2 are reported; if they match the self_low_2 shift the intervention is nonspecific and the primary result does not support a score-specific mechanism
